component.name: Shaya
component.summary: Native AI assistant for Linux, built with Rust and GTK4

description.p: Shaya lives as an overlay on desktop and gives you instant access to AI chat, voice transcription, screenshots, meeting recording and analysis.

Bring your own API key for Anthropic, OpenAI or Groq, or chat with a local model through any OpenAI-compatible server. There is no account and no Shaya server: requests go directly to the provider you choose, everything else stays on your machine.

ul.li: AI chat with conversation context, markdown rendering and system prompts
Microphone or system audio recording with automatic transcription
Full screen or area screenshots attached to the chat as context
Meeting recorder with transcription and AI analysis
Live assistant that listens to a call and suggests what to say
Prompt library, cheatsheets and conversation history
Show or hide with any shortcut set in your desktop or compositor

description.p: First release: AI chat overlay for Linux with cloud or local models
